sequence_name: Combined Pitch - CRM Reactivation + Voice Agent
use_case: When prospect has clear need for both (large database + service-based business with phone inquiries)

steps.subject: {{first_name}} — 2 revenue leaks at {{company_name}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I study {{industry}} businesses for a living, and there are two revenue leaks I see at almost every company like {{company_name}}:

1. Dead leads: Thousands of past prospects sitting in your CRM that nobody's following up with. (You already paid to get them.)

2. Missed calls: 30-40% of inbound calls going to voicemail after hours or during busy times. (78% of those callers will go to a competitor.)

We built AI agents that plug both leaks:
→ Agent #1 works your entire CRM 24/7, re-engaging dead leads and booking appointments
→ Agent #2 answers every inbound call instantly, qualifies the caller, and books them on your calendar

Both cost less than one part-time hire combined.

Worth 15 min to see the numbers?

{{sender_name}}
Realside AI

personalization_variables.ai_personalization_prompt: Research the company's online presence: check Google reviews for mentions of response times, look for job postings (especially receptionists or sales reps), check their website for a phone number and business hours, and look at their Google Business profile for call volume hints.
